name: Munshi Mohammad Meherullah
role: Islamic debater and social reform writer
contribution: He used public debate, pamphlets, and religious argument to defend Muslim communities and address social-religious reform in colonial Bengal.
context: Active in late nineteenth-century Bengal, he worked in an environment shaped by missionary polemics, print culture, and Muslim reformist anxiety.
impact: He became an important voice in Bengali Muslim public debate and helped strengthen religious self-definition through vernacular argument.
highlight: He turned religious debate into a Bengali Muslim public reform practice.
seoTitle: Munshi Mohammad Meherullah: Bengali Muslim Debater and Writer
seoDescription: Learn how Munshi Mohammad Meherullah used Bengali debate, pamphlets, and reform writing to shape Muslim public discussion in late colonial Bengal.
shortAnswer: Munshi Mohammad Meherullah was a Bengali Muslim debater and writer who addressed religious argument and social reform through print and public discussion.
